description: This file defines the DockIconManager class responsible for managing the visibility of the Dock icon in a macOS application. It observes window states and user preferences to dynamically show or hide the Dock icon accordingly.

classes.name: DockIconManager
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the visibility of the application's Dock icon based on window activity and user preferences.

methods.name: updateDockVisibility
methods.description: Determines whether the Dock icon should be visible based on user preference and current window states, updating the application's activation policy accordingly.

methods.name: temporarilyShowDock
methods.description: Temporarily sets the application's activation policy to show the Dock icon.

methods.name: setupObservers
methods.description: Initializes observers for window state changes and user preferences to trigger Dock icon visibility updates.

methods.name: windowVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles notification when window visibility or key status changes, triggering a visibility update.

methods.name: dockPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in user preferences related to Dock icon visibility.
